structure.role: transient confirmation that a save already went through, anchored to the bottom edge of the viewport and removed from the document when it ends

children.role: polite live-region line that states the save happened; the one thing a reader is meant to take from the surface
trailing group holding the two controls the confirmation offers, separated from the message by a hairline rule rather than a filled surface
inline control that reverts the optimistic save; the only element permitted to carry the accent, and it carries it as punctuation on the label rather than as a fill
icon-only control that closes the confirmation immediately without reverting anything; monochrome, recessive, with its own hover and focus-visible states

states.name: absent
states.note: Not in the document at all. The confirmation is added on commit and removed when it ends — never hidden in place.

states.name: entering
states.note: Mounting. The entrance reveals where the surface sits relative to the viewport edge; it does not decorate.

states.name: visible
states.note: Readable and interactive. The auto-dismiss clock runs here and is held while a pointer or keyboard focus is inside the surface.

states.name: leaving
states.note: Exit in progress. The surface is inert to further input so a late click cannot re-enter the machine.

states.name: dismissed
states.note: Removed from the document. The save stands.

states.name: reverted
states.note: Removed from the document because the reader took the undo. The save was rolled back; this outcome is distinct from dismissed and the surrounding surface has to reflect it.

content.voice_constraint: State what happened and stop. No exclamation, no persuasion words, no restating the object that was saved.
One verb. Name the reversal, never soften it into a question.
Names the action for a screen reader only; the control itself shows an icon drawn with the current text colour.

provenance.claim: A bottom-anchored confirmation carrying one inline reversal control and a hover-paused auto-dismiss is the standing shape of an optimistic-save affordance.
The auto-dismiss clock is held while a pointer or keyboard focus is inside the surface, because a timed surface that disappears mid-reach removes the only reversal path.
Component text stays in the body band; the rank difference between the message and the dismiss control is carried by weight or the accent, never by display size.
Undo and dismiss are separate outcomes, so the machine terminates in two distinct states rather than folding the reversal into the ordinary close.
No reference capture was supplied for this build, so every structural rank, order and containment value is inferred from the stated intent rather than measured off a rendered surface.
